prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, early 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long curly lavender hair — wearing a skin-tight micro bodycon mini dress of ultra-thin faded light-wash stretch denim with thin shoulder straps, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to just under her bust, the two sides of the stretch denim fully covering her bust, one wide diagonal band cut away from under her left bust across her stomach down to her right hip, the skin along the whole band bare, the stretch denim remaining over her bust and over the other half of her waist, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the right side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole right thigh and the side of her right hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the stretch denim shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small beauty mark beside her navel and slightly darker skin over her elbows. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin stretch denim molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the clean diagonal edges of the cutout crossing her stomach, the dress stretched taut over the curve of her hips and glutes, the open slit falling in a clean line, fine stretch lines, soft whiskered fading over the hips and a lightly worn matte surface. Pose: walking confidently toward the camera, shoulders back, chin lifted — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy light blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each longer than her middle finger, in light blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.

Background: a sunlit autumn park with orange trees, a stone bridge with a waist-high parapet and a standard bench on a leaf-strewn path, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
